The Up For Air Series is a collection of endurance events created to support improved air quality, while having fun hiking and running on great trails with good people. Proceeds from Up For Area events are donated to non-profit groups; the event directors receive no payment. Salt Lake City resident Jared Campbell started Running Up For Air on Grandeur Peak in 2012, when he became painfully aware of the terrible pollution in the Salt Lake valley, and that the air quality improved when he ran up higher.
